# Philippa Gordon

## Overview

- **Gender:** female  <sub>[v3 c19 P5](../source/v03-c19.md#nw-v03-c19-p0005)</sub>
- **Origin:** Bolingbroke, Nova Scotia  <sub>[v3 c4 P32](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0032)</sub>
- **Titles:** class beauty and belle  <sub>[v3 c6 P13](../source/v03-c06.md#nw-v03-c06-p0013)</sub>
- **Nicknames:** Phil  <sub>[v3 c4 P28](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0028)</sub>

## Appearance

Phil has brown tints to her appearance that are suited by gowns of yellow silk and cobwebby lace. On her wedding day, she made a dainty fairy of a bride.

_Sources: [v3 c19 P5](../source/v03-c19.md#nw-v03-c19-p0005), [v3 c39 P39](../source/v03-c39.md#nw-v03-c39-p0039)_

## Personality

Philippa possesses an open, non-shy demeanor and a frivolous, chattering exterior, though she is loyal and crystal-free from snobbishness. She loves to be popular and views her suitors as good comrades and playfellows. Goodhearted, sweet, and charming, she has a natural knack for making people like her.

_Sources: [v3 c4 P28](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0028), [v3 c4 P60](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0060), [v3 c4 P71](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0071), [v3 c5 P2](../source/v03-c05.md#nw-v03-c05-p0002), [v3 c19 P37](../source/v03-c19.md#nw-v03-c19-p0037), [v3 c27 P21](../source/v03-c27.md#nw-v03-c27-p0021), [v3 c27 P31](../source/v03-c27.md#nw-v03-c27-p0031), [v3 c37 P34](../source/v03-c37.md#nw-v03-c37-p0034)_

## History

Philippa Gordon attended Redmond College, where her background, beauty, and charm opened doors to social circles, allowing her to introduce her new friends Anne Shirley and Priscilla Grant to college life. She competed closely with Anne and Gilbert Blythe for leadership in Freshman classes while simultaneously torn between two hometown suitors, Alec and Alonzo. Before her second year, she joined Anne, Priscilla, and Stella Maynard in renting Patty's Place under the chaperonage of Aunt Jamesina. While spending time at Prospect Point, she met Jonas Blake, a minister and fellow Redmond graduate, and fell deeply in love with him. Determined to prove her cleverness to Jonas, she aimed for the Johnson Scholarship in Mathematics and accepted his proposal of marriage. Despite initial disapproval from her mother, she held firm to her engagement, completed her studies at Redmond, and married Jonas in Bolingbroke with Anne serving as her bridesmaid. Later, she wrote to Gilbert Blythe to inform him that Anne was not engaged to Roy Gardner, encouraging him to try again.
